excluded_packages.name: wln-build-molecular-graph
excluded_packages.reason: Documented executable run.py is not delivered; command requires an old virtual environment and batch workspace.

excluded_packages.name: retroprime-two-stage-retrosynthesis
excluded_packages.reason: Resource recovery instructions depend on another Skill package through an incorrect relative link; package is not independently self-contained.

excluded_packages.name: attach-semi-template-residuals
excluded_packages.reason: Template representation and attachment operations are undefined; map/match/replace alone does not specify a reliable graph rewrite.

excluded_packages.name: chem-diffdock-nim
excluded_packages.reason: Only checks two files exist and the endpoint string is nonempty; little DiffDock-specific preparation value.

excluded_packages.name: chem-genmol
excluded_packages.reason: Only checks a repository directory and checkpoint file exist; no SAFE or task-configuration guidance.

excluded_packages.name: chem-openmm-md
excluded_packages.reason: Only enumerates available platforms; better as a preparation step than a standalone simulation Skill.

excluded_packages.name: chem-reinvent
excluded_packages.reason: Claims to check the configuration path, but only checks executable availability; little task-specific help.

excluded_packages.name: construct-leaving-group-vocabulary
excluded_packages.reason: Attachment-marker encoding and ambiguous component alignment are undefined; source references point to an old local workspace.

excluded_packages.name: correct-and-filter-semi-template-pairs
excluded_packages.reason: No usable paired predictor contract, template vocabulary or pair-prior construction is established.

excluded_packages.name: experience-guided-retrosynthetic-search
excluded_packages.reason: The core PUCT expression is damaged, with no definite implementation entrypoint to resolve selection behavior.

excluded_packages.name: generate-and-filter-chemical-reasoning-examples
excluded_packages.reason: Requires a score of at least 4/5 but supplies no scoring rubric, leaving the main acceptance rule undefined.

excluded_packages.name: generate-reactant-graphs-with-valid-action-beam-search
excluded_packages.reason: Valid-action rules and atom/bond vocabularies are neither defined nor tied to a usable predictor.

excluded_packages.name: gln-support-restricted-training
excluded_packages.reason: The required gradient equation and weighting for the uniform-sampling approximation are missing.

excluded_packages.name: graph-aware-molecular-attention
excluded_packages.reason: Distance buckets are specified, but the attention equation needed to produce the promised representations is not.

excluded_packages.name: graphretro-beam-search-retrosynthesis
excluded_packages.reason: Final attachment and stereochemistry rules depend on a missing appendix; references use old local paths.

excluded_packages.name: localretro-extract-local-template
excluded_packages.reason: The documented scripts/extract_template.py entrypoint is not included.

excluded_packages.name: localtransform-forward-prediction
excluded_packages.reason: Mostly generic file/commit checks; the command depends on the old repository/evidence layout.

excluded_packages.name: rdkit-descriptor-result-triage
excluded_packages.reason: Duplicates the existing descriptor calculator and interpretation boundary with substantially more template text.

excluded_packages.name: robustify-rgn-against-synthon-errors
excluded_packages.reason: Does not define target alignment when erroneous synthons change component counts or correspondence, the core augmentation case.
